results.content:
We record in Screen-Studio and edit in CapCut—our go-to combo for creating quick, polished content. CapCut is incredibly intuitive and beginner-friendly, yet packed with enough features to make your videos look professional. From auto-captions and transitions to sound effects and motion presets, it’s got everything you need to produce high-quality edits without the steep learning curve. Tip: Use CapCut’s auto-caption and AI-based background remover to save time on common editing tasks—especially useful for social-first content like launch videos, tutorials, and product demos. We explored other options like Premiere Pro and Descript. (Descript has great voice editing!) While those tools offer deeper customization, CapCut hit the sweet spot for speed, ease of use, and quality—especially for [...] #### What needs improvement

#### What needs improvement

I would give zero stars if I could. I tried to cancel this subscription two months ago and I am still being charged. I reached out to CapCut support using the same email tied to my account, gave them my account details, screenshots, and billing information multiple times, and instead of getting a clear answer, I got nothing but the runaround. [...] Report

#### What's great

Honestly, CapCut completely lowered the barrier to entry for video editing. I use it mostly for short-form video, and the AI auto-captions save me so much time it’s ridiculous. I am an aspiring content creator so this is very helpful. It handles cuts, trending audio, and transitions way faster than any heavy desktop software I’ve tried. It’s just super intuitive.

#### What needs improvement

The pro features paywall is getting a little aggressive lately. A lot of basic effects that used to be free are now locked behind the subscription, which is a bummer for casual creators.
